# FLOSS 3.1.1 and what it needs, with their hashes, for the backend image's
# own FLOSS environment (/opt/floss) on arm64, where FLARE publishes no
# standalone build (docker/Dockerfile.backend, stage floss-arm64). One package,
# binary2strings, publishes no Linux wheel and is built from its hashed sdist
# against requirements-build.txt, installed first. Keep flare-floss in step with
# FLOSS_VERSION in src/malspark/tools/emulated_strings.py. Regenerate with
#   echo 'flare-floss==3.1.1' > req.in
#   uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.13 --generate-hashes --no-header req.in
# and install with pip install --require-hashes --no-build-isolation -r requirements.txt.
